## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `2f73214d8a7d09d30e3fe605a2a68239b9f2177c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the whole diff of #36790, `git diff e0f0e9f7da7355b84da76e13821ba18a082eb9ec 2f73214d8a7d09d30e3fe605a2a68239b9f2177c` (23 files, 4 commits). Contract face (the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declaration): `ui/packages/types/src/data-display.ts` (`DataTableSchema.renderRowContextMenu`), `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hans,zh-Hant}.ts`, `.changeset/36289-list-cell-context-menu.md`. Files in the diff that implement or consume it: `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/{ObjectGrid.tsx,components/RowContextMenu.tsx,objectGridCellFacts.ts}`, the tests `components/.../data-table-row-context-menu-28434.test.tsx` and `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/{cellContextMenu-36289,rowContextMenu-28434,phoneCardRowActions-29150}.test.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-grid/README.md`, `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx`. Cited and read only: `components/.../dataTableCellSelection.ts` (`defaultValueFromText`), `plugin-grid/src/index.tsx` (what the package exports), the `exports` maps of `@object-ui/{types,components,plugin-grid,i18n}`, the `GridCellFacts` producer in `ObjectGrid.tsx` (`describeCell`), `fieldHistoryCellMenu-36290.test.tsx`, AGENTS.md's changeset rule.
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

Everything below comes from reading the diff and the tree at the head. Nothing was run. The PR body and card #36289 were read for context. The head matches the PR's `head.sha`; it did not move.

### ① Derived judgments

**The widening declaration is right and complete.**
- `DataTableSchema.renderRowContextMenu`'s context gains one optional member, `cell?: { copy?: () => void; paste?: () => void; clear?: () => void }`. This is the seam #36661 widened with `column`. A host callback typed against the old context still type-checks, because the context it receives is a subtype of what it declared. Nothing in the context is removed or retyped.
- Five keys are added under `table` in all eleven shipped packs: `copyCell`, `pasteCell`, `clearCell`, `pasteNotValue`, `pasteUnavailable` (five per pack, checked per file). `@object-ui/i18n` publishes them through `./locales` and `./locales/*`. No key is removed or renamed. zh-Hant matches zh-Hans as generated.
- There are no other new public names. `RowContextMenuCell` and the `cell` prop on `RowContextMenuItems` live in `components/RowContextMenu.tsx`, and `pastesFromText` lives in `objectGridCellFacts.ts`. `plugin-grid/src/index.tsx` exports none of them, and the package's `exports` map has only `.`. The two notes added to `TABLE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` and the three items added to `CONTEXT_MENU_FALLBACKS` are module-private English mirrors of the pack keys. No component prop on a public export changes.
- Nothing is narrowed on a published type. `column` keeps its #36290 meaning in every case that can occur (see N1 for the one theoretical exception).

**The new member's shape works for consumers.**
- The verbs are nullary and return nothing, and the table owns the outcome: the conversion, the editor's checks, the save, and the note on the cell. A host only has to draw items, so it cannot paste around the checks. That fits the "host supplies only the items" rule the slot already states.
- "Absent means the table would refuse it" lets a host draw an item as unavailable without knowing the table's rules. The shape gives no reason why an item is unavailable, so a host cannot explain a greyed item. That is acceptable for a first widening, and the member can add a reason later without breaking anyone.
- `cell` always appears together with `column`, so a host reading `cell` already has the column, and the pair stays consistent.

**Behaviour changes a consumer will see are declared.** Ctrl/Cmd+V on a selected cell now runs `GridCellFacts.validate` and shows `table.pasteNotValue`. Before, it saved any text or dropped it without a word. The changeset says so in its last bullet. This changes what a UI path accepts. It is not a published accepted-set: no schema, metadata key or API input moves, and the server's own rules are unchanged. It does not need a `(narrowing)` arm.

### ② Semver level

- `patch` on `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/i18n`, all four published. This follows AGENTS.md's changeset rule: a non-protocol change, widening included, ships `patch`. Only a `Metadata-protocol` kind other than `none` forces `minor`.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is right. `renderRowContextMenu` is a runtime slot that the zod twin refuses by name (`handlerKeyRefusal`), and pack keys are not something a metadata author writes. No spec key, accepted value or metadata type moves.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` appears at the start of a line in both the PR body and the changeset, and both name the same surfaces: the `cell` member and the five keys. No `major`: nothing is removed or retyped.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Pins fail without the fix, by reading.** On the base, `data-table-row-context-menu-28434`'s exact-equality `toHaveBeenCalledWith(..., { selected, column, cell: { copy } })` would fail because the base has no `cell`. So would the new describe block's `['clear','copy','paste']` key set and the masked `{}` case. Every case in `cellContextMenu-36289` relies on `row-context-cell-*` items that the base never draws. The Ctrl+V-refuses case fails on the base, which saved `not an address`.
- **No test was weakened in a way that hides a regression.** `rowContextMenu-28434` and `phoneCardRowActions-29150` now filter out `row-context-cell-*` and `row-context-field-history`, so they compare only the row's section. The row's items and their order are still compared exactly. The position of Change history is now pinned by `cellContextMenu-36289`, and its presence and absence by the unchanged `fieldHistoryCellMenu-36290`.
- **Downstream apps.** No other implementation of `renderRowContextMenu` in this repo or its UI packages has to change: `ObjectGrid` is the only host. The new pack keys are additive.
- **SQL / id materialization.** Not touched; client-only change.
- **Author.** PR `user.login` is `os-warren`, not `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment

This PR's surfaces are the `Clause-②: yes` declaration alone. They include no published schema, governed rule text or narrowing, so ④ is not required. For the record:
- Having the table hand verbs, rather than having the host reimplement copy, paste and clear, keeps one path per action: `copyCellValue` for Ctrl+C and Copy, `pasteIntoCell` for Ctrl+V and Paste, `clearCell` for Backspace and Clear. The card asks for "the same behaviour as the shortcut" and "the same checks and save as in-cell editing". This shape is what makes those hold.
- The extra `pasteable` (by field type) gate lives in the host and stays out of the published member. That is the right split: the table cannot know a field type's paste semantics, and `ObjectGrid` can.

Findings:

- **N1:** `rowContextMenuItems` now builds `cell ? { selected, column, cell } : { selected }`. When `cellMenuOf` returns `undefined`, because the `data-cell-column` value names no entry in `columns`, `column` is dropped as well. The JSDoc says `cell` is "present exactly when `column` is", and #36290 promised `column` whenever the menu opens on a data cell. Every `data-cell-column` the table draws is a `columns` accessor, so this cannot happen today. Passing `column` whenever it is defined would keep the #36290 member independent of the new one.
- **N2:** The JSDoc says `clear` is absent "on a required … cell". The table knows a field is required only through the host's `GridCellFacts.clearRefusal`. A bare `data-table` host, or `ObjectGrid` under `cellSelection={false}`, supplies no facts and receives `clear` on a required column. The sentence should say "where the host's cell facts refuse a clear".
- **N3:** `cell` gives no reason for an absent verb, so a host cannot tell a reader why Paste or Clear is greyed. The table already has that sentence (`readOnlyReasonOf`, `clearRefusal`). An optional reason can be added later as a widening.

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1) · repo:objectstack#1 · head `2f73214d` · 2026-11-23T23:20Z

- **Shape:** `Fixes #36289`. `ui/packages/types/src/data-display.ts` (optional `cell` on the row-menu context), `components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`, `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `components/RowContextMenu.tsx`, `objectGridCellFacts.ts`, five `table.*` keys in all 11 locales, tests, the plugin-grid docs page, a patch changeset. Clause-②: yes (widening). Metadata-protocol: none.
- **Record half:** same-head TIER_DEFAULT PASS 7116834063 at `2f73214d`, nits only.
- **Read:**
  - Paste and Ctrl+V share `pasteIntoCell`, which is held to the cell editor's validation.
  - Clear is disabled on required fields. Paste and Clear are disabled on read-only or unwritable cells (masked, read-only, a non-editable grid, no update permission). Paste is disabled on lookup, person and multi-choice fields.
  - A clipboard denial is explained on the cell.
  - Change history moved into the cell block. The row block's items and order are unchanged, and the existing row-menu tests still compare them exactly.
  - The write path is the record save alone.
- **Acceptance notes (declared in the PR):** Ctrl+V of text the editor refuses no longer saves. On an editable grid with no row actions, right-clicking a writable cell now opens the app's menu.
- **Nits, not blocking:**
  - Paste reads the field type from the object schema, so it can be greyed on a writable text cell until the schema loads.
  - Under the opt-in staged model (`cellSelection={false}`, unused in-repo), the required-field rule has no cell facts to read.
  - A Paste from an empty clipboard shows no note.
  - The unaffected-view-draft point is pinned only by browser frames.
- **Gates:** 54 success, 12 expected skip, 0 failed on `2f73214d`; mergeable_state clean.
- **Landing:** the seat readies the PR and arms auto-merge.
